work.title: Support Ticket Text Processing
bullets: Implemented Python routines to normalize support ticket text and validate required fields before ingestion into an existing classification pipeline.
Added regression tests for malformed records, missing descriptions, and inconsistent encodings; documented processing failures for maintenance follow-up.

projects.title: Baseline Sentiment Classification of Product Reviews
bullets: Implemented a scikit-learn sentiment classification baseline using TF-IDF features and logistic regression, with separate training and evaluation partitions.
Compared predictions against a majority-class baseline and inspected misclassified reviews for negation, mixed sentiment, and vocabulary absent from training data.
